plugins.readme_text:
# deepseek-balance

DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web plugin — 实时查看 DeepSeek API 余额，以悬浮窗展示。

A DSH Web client plugin that displays your DeepSeek API balance (total / topped-up / granted) in a real-time floating window (悬浮窗), refreshed every 30 seconds.

## Features

- 🪟 **Floating window** — draggable overlay card rendered in the DSH `shell.overlay` slot, collapsible via `− / +`.
- 🔄 **Real-time refresh** — polls the balance every 30 s (configurable) plus a manual refresh button.
- 🔒 **Key stays on host** — the host half reads the `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` credential and proxies `GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance`; the API key never reaches the browser.
- 🌓 **Theme-aware** — uses the DSH design tokens (`--dsw-*`) so it matches light/dark mode.

## Requirements

- A running DSH web profile (`dsh --profile web`).
- A DeepSeek API key stored through the credentials service (`DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`), or exported in the launching environment.

## Install

Register the plugin in the web profile's `cordis.patch.yml` and install the package into the profile's `node_modules`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: deepseek-balance
      name: deepseek-balance
```

Then place this package (or a symlink) under `~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/deepseek-balance/`, restart `dsh web`, and refresh the GUI — the floating balance window appears.

## Files

- `lib/index.js` — host half: registers the `/deepseek-balance` proxy route.
- `lib/client.js` — client bundle: renders the floating window and polls the route.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的 Plan-and-Execute 编排插件
plugins.readme_text:
Plan-and-Execute orchestration plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). ![dsh plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-plugin-8B5CF6.svg) ![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-3178C6.svg?logo=typescript&logoColor=white) ![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.19-339933.svg?logo=nodedotjs&logoColor=white) ![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg) [![Awesome DSH Plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/badge.svg)](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)

by Jimmy Zhang

DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的 Plan-and-Execute 编排插件 ## 安装 **npm 包直接安装（无需构建，安装后重启dsh服务）** ```sh npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plan-and-execute npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web ``` > 需要 dsh **0.1.7 及以上**（本版按会话格式 v4 的 source 生产者归属、系统提示占 surface node 0、settings volatile 配置字段适配）。更早的 dsh 请安装 `dsh-plan-and-execute@0.5.0`。 ## 使用方式 在 Web UI 对话框里输入 `/plan-and-execute 提示词...` ## 使用示例一 ```sh /plan-and-execute 根据以下要求帮我生成 **2026年国庆假期（10月1日–10月7日）** 北京一地 **7天6晚** 的详细出游计划。 ## 基础参数 - **出行人数**：一家三口（含儿童，年龄 8 岁） - **出行方式**：自驾（京牌私家车） - **住宿标准**：经济型/舒适型宾馆（每晚预算 400–600 元） - **总经费**：15,000 元人民币（含交通、住宿、门票、餐饮、停车及其他杂费） - **出发地**：北京市内（无需长途驾驶） ## 输出要求（逐日清单） - **每日行程**：上午 / 下午 / 晚上 分时段活动，标注景点名称及建议游玩时长 - **门票前置**：标明需提前购票的景区（并备注官方渠道及抢票时间） - **停车方案**：每个景点附近推荐停车场（含大致停车费/小时） - **住宿安排**：每晚游玩结束后，推荐附近 2–3 家宾馆（含参考价格及是否可免费停车） - **餐饮建议**：每日推荐 1–2 家地道餐厅（人均 50–80 元） - **费用概览**：每日分项预估费用（门票 + 停车 + 住宿 + 餐饮），并滚动累计，确保总支出 ≤ 15,000 元 ## 附加约束 - 避开热门景点人流高峰时段（建议早 8:00 前或下午 15:00 后入园） - 每天车程累计不超过 1.5 小时（市区内） - 安排 1 天机动日（用以应对天气或体力调整） - 最后一天（10月7日）需预留返程休整时间 ## 输出格式 - 按日期分节（Day 1 – Day 7） - 每节包含：行程表、停车点、住宿推荐、餐饮提示、当日费用小计 - 文末附 **总预算核对表**（分类汇总） 请直接生成完整计划，无需额外解释。 ``` ## 使用示例二 ```sh /plan-and-execute - 按以下规格实现一个B/S文档阅读工具。 ### 需求 - **架构**：前后端分离，HTTP/RESTful API。 - **前端**：Vue 3 单页应用，左侧目录树（可展开/折叠），右侧展示文档内容。使用 Claude Code 生成代码。 - **后端**：Node.js（Hono），启动时加载指定根目录下的所有 `.txt` / `.md` 文件，构建目录树，提供文件树结构和文件内容读取接口。使用 Claude Code 生成代码。 - **交互**：点击树节点，请求后端获取文件内容并渲染（MD 需转为 HTML）。 - **测试**：开发完成后，使用 Codex 生成并执行单元/集成测试。 ### 接口 - `GET /api/tree` → 返回目录树 JSON（含路径、类型、名称） - `GET /api/content?path=xxx` → 返回文件内容（纯文本或 HTML） ### 约束 - 代码精简，注释适度，支持中文文件名和路径。 - 后端仅读取指定根目录（环境变量 `DOC_ROOT`），禁止越权。 - 前端打包输出静态文件，可独立部署。 ### 输出 - 工程保存到 `~/git/{project}` 目录，目录下分成前/后端两个工程。 - 完整项目结构、关键代码片段、启动说明。直接交付可运行原型。 ``` ## 开发 ```sh pnpm install && pnpm link:host # link:host 软链宿主包（DSH_ROOT 默认 ~/git/deepseek-harness，需先在 dsh 仓库 pnpm install && pnpm run build） pnpm test # vitest 单测 pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check pnpm dev # 在 dsh checkout 启动 Web UI 并加载本插件（绝对路径 overlay） ``` ## 配置（cordis.yml `config`） | 键 | 默认 | 说明 | | ------------------- | --------- | ------------------------------- | | `onStepFailure` | `'pause'` | 步骤失败：暂停问人 / 自愈重试 | | `maxAutoRecoveries` | `2` | 自愈次数上限（仅 auto-recover） | | `planDir` | `'.pae'` | 计划根目录（相对会话 cwd） | ## 手工验收清单（`pnpm dev` + Web UI） 1. `/plan-and-execute 给本仓库写一个加法函数并配测试` → 模型调研、写步骤文件、调 `submit_plan` → 审批弹窗 2. 审批选"继续修改"并输入反馈 → 模型收到反馈重新提交 → 再审批 3. 选"批准" → TodoPanel 出现步骤清单；无确认点的计划连续执行到完成；完成弹窗含各步 summary 4. 在计划里让模型给某步标 `requiresConfirmation: true` → 该步执行前弹确认点（继续/跳过/回计划/终止） 5. 执行中按取消（或让某步失败）→ 暂停五选项（重试/跳过/继续下一步/回计划/终止） 6. 执行中直接发消息 → 消息进入当前步（原生 steer 语义），编排不受影响 7. 执行中途重启 `pnpm dev` 并重开会话 → 恢复确认弹出，"从断点继续"后从当前步重注入 8. 验收全程结束后：`git -C ~/git/deepseek-harness status --porcelain` 输出为空（宿主仓库零改动）

plugins.readme_text:
---
summary: SQLite-backed personal todo tools and Web panel for DeepSeek Harness.
read_when:
  - You want durable todos shared across DSH sessions and projects.
  - You are installing or configuring the dsh-personal-todo bundle.
---

# dsh-personal-todo

English | [Chinese](README.zh.md)

`dsh-personal-todo` lets users manage todos themselves or dispatch them to a DSH Agent on demand, without choosing a task type in advance. Todo progress is independent of Agent execution state. See the [Chinese documentation](README.zh.md) for the complete guide.

## Features

- Read-only requests such as “show my todos” use `personal_todo_show`. The tool area retains only the host's compact record, while a complete interactive todo card appears at the end of the turn instead of a Markdown table. The card supports all item actions, scrolling through every result within a fixed height, and opening the right sidebar at a specific todo.
- Historical cards in conversations, the right sidebar, the sidebar count, and `@` references share one client-side data store through Nanostores and React `useSyncExternalStore`. A change in any location is reflected immediately everywhere else. Cards refresh when mounted, when the window regains focus, after a manual refresh, and after successful actions; existing data remains visible if a refresh fails.
- The panel and Agent tools support complete JSON import and export. Exports use version 2, while imports accept versions 1 and 2. Duplicate IDs are skipped, and only newly imported todos with legacy running records are reset to pending. Live execution state is not written to backups, and importing never starts an Agent. See the [Chinese documentation](README.zh.md) for more details.
- `@` references in the chat composer show only pending and in-progress todos. Press Tab to enter the todo list, search by keyword, and retrieve the latest details when sending. This requires DSH `ui-input-trigger >=0.1.2-rc.1`.
- Durable SQLite storage with schema versioning, WAL, foreign keys, a busy timeout, and owner-only filesystem permissions.
- Each todo dispatched to an Agent is associated with one persistent root Session, and all follow-up communication stays in the original conversation.
- Automatic discovery of delegated child Sessions, including nested children, as related todo conversations.
- After a service restart, Session state is read without activating an Agent or sending a recovery message.
- The sidebar shows the combined number of unarchived pending and in-progress todos; there is no separate “needs my attention” filter.
- Primary progress uses `pending`, `in_progress`, and `completed`; `cancelled` is a secondary state, and archiving is independent. Agent execution information is displayed separately.
- Session associations and user action history are retained, along with legacy Runs and results for compatibility. New executions do not create Runs.
- Agent tools are limited to creating, querying, editing, deleting, importing, and exporting todos. They do not force synchronization of progress, questions, or review results.
- The panel uses the host's native right Sidebar Tab. Its primary tabs are Pending, In Progress, and Completed; More contains cancelled and archived todos, while Data has a separate menu. Todos can be grouped by assignee, moved through states manually, and linked back to their Sessions. The panel no longer includes a reply box or review workflow.
- Todos in any lifecycle state can move to a separate archive view, then return to the matching list or be permanently deleted.
- Typed English and Chinese client dictionaries.

## Requirements

- A DeepSeek Harness Web profile that supports right Sidebar Tabs, `sessionQuery`, and Agent lifecycle notifications; the implementation targets the `0.2.0-rc.2` interfaces.
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-tool 0.2.0-rc.2` and `@deepseek-ai/cordis ~4.0.4`.
- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`.
- pnpm `11.7.0` for development.

## Installation

Install a pinned GitHub revision so the committed `lib/` artifacts are used directly:

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add github:zsspub/dsh-personal-todo#<commit-sha>
```

For local development:

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-personal-todo
```

The bundle patch mounts the Host service and tools. Its Web manifest loads the client automatically.

## Agent tools

| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `personal_todo_add` | Create and save a todo without executing it. Supports notes, assignee, priority, due time, and tags; the default priority is medium. |
| `personal_todo_show` | Handle read-only display requests by rendering a live card at the end of the turn. The model adds only a brief summary instead of repeating every item or generating a Markdown table. |
| `personal_todo_list` | Return complete JSON for subsequent Agent editing, deletion, or data processing. Older logs also render the same card. |
| `personal_todo_update` | Replace any supplied mutable fields; `null` clears notes, assignee, or due time and `[]` clears tags. |
| `personal_todo_delete` | Permanently delete one todo by UUID. |
| `personal_todo_export` | Return a complete `{ filename, json }` backup for the host's file tools to save. |
| `personal_todo_import` | Accept `{ json }`, import incrementally, and return the numbers of imported, skipped, and execution-reset todos. |

Lists return pending and in-progress todos by default and exclude archived todos. Conversation cards retain bounded historical snapshots and use their original filters to read current data. Cards with identical filters share complete paginated requests, and the cards themselves do not poll. Cards do not offer creation, duplication, or JSON import and export. Deletion always requires confirmation, and dangerous state changes on a running todo first require confirmation that execution should stop. The `needsAttention` filter and count, along with the `personal_todo_progress`, `personal_todo_block`, and `personal_todo_submit_review` tools, have been removed. General editing cannot change todo progress, and Agent tools cannot confirm completion on the user's behalf. The Remote API retains `setStatus({ id, status }, signal)`, `stop({ id }, signal)`, and `approve`, which is equivalent to marking a todo complete; `reply` and `requestChanges` have been removed.

## Task flow

Creating a todo or manually marking it in progress does not create a Session or send a message. Execution starts only when the user chooses “Dispatch to Agent”; questions, replies, permission confirmations, and results remain in the original conversation. `executionStatus` passively observes `agent/status`, `agent/error`, `agent/disposed`, and `session/event`, projecting `running`, `idle`, `failed`, `stopped`, or `unavailable` in memory only. The end of a turn does not mean the todo is complete, and the plugin does not infer that a reply or review is required. Listeners do not use blocking hooks, write progress summaries, or send messages. Cold Sessions are inspected through the read-only `sessionQuery.readSession` API without activating execution. Users can stop and take over a todo, complete it, cancel it, return it to pending, or archive it; reopening a todo or restarting DSH never starts execution automatically. See the [Chinese documentation](README.zh.md) for more details.

## Configuration

The included bundle uses these defaults:

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `databasePath` | `$DSH_HOME/personal-todo/todos.sqlite3` | Absolute SQLite file path. |
| `journalMode` | `wal` | SQLite journal mode: `wal`, `delete`, `truncate`, or `persist`. |
| `busyTimeoutMs` | `5000` | Time SQLite waits for a busy writer. |
| `defaultListLimit` | `50` | Page size when callers omit `limit`. |
| `maxListLimit` | `200` | Maximum accepted page size. |
| `agentPreset` | unset | Optional Agent preset for todo-created root Sessions. |

Override the generated plugin entry in the profile patch when deployment policy requires different values. The service rejects relative paths, invalid limits, and databases with a schema newer than it supports.

## Data behavior

Titles are trimmed and limited to 200

plugins.description: dsh-plugin: encrypted backup / restore / migration of the dsh home config through a private GitHub repo
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-vault

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A [dsh](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that backs up your dsh home config — **encrypted** — to your own private GitHub repo, and pulls it flat onto a new machine with one command: restore the config, reinstall plugins from the manifest. Cross-machine restore doubles as migration.

**Requires dsh >= 0.2.0-rc.2** — this plugin targets the dsh RC/stable line only (CI and releases resolve the newest of the `latest`/`next` dist-tags at runtime). **The alpha line is no longer supported.**

Zero npm dependencies: encryption uses only Node's built-in `crypto` (scrypt + AES-256-GCM); GitHub transfer goes through the REST API.

## Commands

```
/vault backup [passphrase]        Back up and push (creates the private repo if missing)
/vault list                       Table of every machine's backup in the vault
                                  (machine / description / snapshot time / file count / size, ← this machine)
/vault restore [machine] [--yes] [passphrase]
                                  No machine name = list snapshots
                                  Picking another machine = migration; --yes actually executes
/vault config                     Show current settings
/vault set repo <owner/name>      Override the default vault repo name
/vault set machine-desc <desc>    Machine description (recorded in the snapshot manifest,
                                  for identification when picking across machines)
/vault set remember-passphrase on|off
                                  When on, the next backup with a passphrase stores it in
                                  the macOS keychain for automatic reuse
```

## Configuration

Since dsh 0.1.7 a legacy `settings.yaml` is imported once at boot and renamed
`settings.yaml.imported`; plugin settings live in the profile patch instead.
The config entry is `dsh-vault` in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` — the same entry `/vault set` writes back to (hot, no restart):

```yaml
- id: dsh-vault
  name: '@aiwayds/dsh-vault'
  config:
    repo: ""                        # owner/name override; empty = default dsh-backup-<login>
    machineDescription: ""          # human label recorded in the snapshot manifest
    rememberPassphrase: false       # store the passphrase in the macOS keychain on backup
```

A pre-upgrade top-level `vault:` section in `settings.yaml` does **not** migrate
automatically (the entry id is `dsh-vault`, the old section was `vault`) — the
original lines survive in `settings.yaml.imported`; re-enter them with
`/vault set`.

Passphrase sources, in order: inline command argument (never logged) →
`$DSH_VAULT_PASSPHRASE` → the macOS keychain (when `rememberPassphrase` is
on). GitHub credentials come from `$GITHUB_TOKEN` or a logged-in `gh` CLI.

The plugin ships a bundled skill (`dsh-vault-config`): ask the agent to configure
backups or run a first backup and the guide loads automatically — it walks
the choices interactively (repo, machine description, passphrase memory) and
writes the `dsh-vault` config entry for you.

## Uninstall

```bash
dsh plugin --profile tui remove @aiwayds/dsh-vault
```

The host cleans up the profile automatically: the `dsh.profile.bundles` entry is spliced and the plugin's patch layer drops. This is a secrets/backup plugin, so be explicit about what **outlives** the removal — none of it is touched by `remove`:

1. **The macOS Keychain item** (service + account `dsh-vault`) holding a remembered passphrase. Turn it off before uninstalling with `/vault set remember-passphrase off`, or delete the item afterwards in Keychain Access.
2. **The private GitHub repo `dsh-backup-<login>`** holding your encrypted snapshots (auto-created on first backup) — delete it on GitHub if unwanted.
3. **`~/.dsh/vault/stash/`** — up to 3 pre-restore stashes of the full config, including `.credentials.yaml` (mode 0600). Purge with `rm -r ~/.dsh/vault`.
4. **The `dsh-vault` config entry in the profile patch (`cordis.patch.yml`)** and the archived `vault:` section inside `~/.dsh/settings.yaml.imported` — remove the lines by hand.

## Backup set

**In**: `settings.yaml`, `settings.yaml.imported` (the archived pre-0.1.7 settings; backed up when present), `.credentials.yaml` (API keys), `APPEND_SYSTEM.md`, `agents/`, each profile's manifest four-pack (`package.json` / `pnpm-lock.yaml` / `pnpm-workspace.yaml` / `cordis.patch.yml` — the patch is where 0.1.7+ plugin settings live), the home-level `cordis.patch.yml`, and `models-store.json`.

**Out**: `sessions/`, `storages/`, every `node_modules` (reinstalled from the manifest), `cordis.yml` (unconditionally rewritten by the host at startup), `.anonymous-user-id`, usage stats.

## Security model

- Snapshots are encrypted whole before leaving the machine: passphrase → scrypt-derived key → AES-256-GCM (vault format v1; the header carries its KDF parameters and a version).
- The private repo is only the first door (token leakage); encryption is the data door. **A lost passphrase means the snapshot is unrecoverable — the plugin offers no recovery.**
- Three ways to supply the passphrase: inline in the command (`recordInput: false`, never lands in session logs) → the `$DSH_VAULT_PASSPHRASE` env var → the macOS keychain (stored automatically when `remember-passphrase on`).
- Before backup, an encrypt-then-decrypt self-check ensures a bad snapshot never replaces a good one; before restore, the current config is stashed to `~/.dsh/vault/stash/` (last 3 kept).
- GitHub credentials: reuses `$GITHUB_TOKEN` or a logged-in `gh` CLI; login is not this plugin's job.

## Vault layout

```
dsh-backup-<github username>/          ← private; override with /vault set repo
└── machines/<hostname>/
    ├── snapshot.enc               ← encrypted snapshot (latest only, overwrite by design)
    └── manifest.json              ← plaintext metadata (machine / description / time / file
                                       list — no key material)
```

## Known limitations

- `file:` absolute-path deps in a profile manifest (locally linked plugins) are invalid on another machine; restore warns about them and you handle those manually.
- `.env` and `storages/` (machine-absolute paths) don't migrate; session history doesn't migrate.
- Only the latest snapshot per machine is kept (deliberate, see ADR 0003) — adding history would be a format-level change.
- Restore's plugin reinstall needs the `dsh` CLI and `pnpm` on PATH.

## Development

```bash
pnpm install && pnpm build && pnpm test   # unit tests (24)
node scripts/smoke-boot.mjs               # real-host boot smoke (scratch profile)
node scripts/e2e-host.mjs                 # real GitHub round-trip (sandbox home + scratch repo)
./e2e/run-e2e.sh                          # podman container e2e (isolated ~/.dsh)
```

Design docs: [CONTEXT.md](./CONTEXT.md) (glossary) and [docs/adr/](./docs/adr/) (backup-set boundary, encryption scheme, overwrite snapshots, single-repo multi-machine layout).

# dsh-theme-studio

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-theme-studio?color=cb3837&logo=npm&logoColor=white)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-theme-studio)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-theme-studio?color=cb3837)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-theme-studio)
[![CI](https://github.com/hj01857655/dsh-theme-studio/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/hj01857655/dsh-theme-studio/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-theme-studio?color=blue)](LICENSE)
[![node](https://img.shields.io/node/v/dsh-theme-studio?color=339933&logo=node.js&logoColor=white)](package.json)
[![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/hj01857655/dsh-theme-studio?color=yellow)](https://github.com/hj01857655/dsh-theme-studio/stargazers)
[![dsh plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-plugin-4B8BBE)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

A [dsh](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that customizes the UI theme: accent presets, a custom accent color, content density, font family, an animation toggle, and raw design-token overrides.

## What it can and cannot change

This plugin only writes design tokens that **actually exist in dsh**, verified by reading the shipped stylesheets (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-theme/lib/client.js`). Every token it writes is listed in `src/tokens.ts` and enforced by `tests/tokens.test.mjs`.

Changes go through **`ctx.theme.overrideTokens()`** — dsh's own theme service — not direct DOM writes. See [Mechanism](#mechanism) for what that buys.

That constraint has two visible consequences:

- **No border-radius control.** dsh hardcodes `border-radius` per component — including `50%` circles and `corner-shape: round` — and ships no radius token. There is no faithful way to offer this, so it is not offered.
- **The animation toggle is a stylesheet, not a token.** dsh ships no motion tokens, so disabling animations injects a rule compressing transition and animation durations to `0.001ms` rather than `0s` — a zero duration can stop `transitionend` / `animationend` from firing and hang components that wait on them. The sheet is owned by this plugin's effect scope, so unloading removes it.

## Features

- **12 presets**: Ocean, Forest, Sunset, Monochrome, Nord, Dracula, Gruvbox, Solarized, Tokyo Night, Catppuccin, Rosé, Ember
- **Dark-aware presets** — a preset whose dark accent differs from its light one adapts automatically when dsh enters dark mode
- **Custom accent color**, plus a separate dark-mode accent
- **Contrast guard** — a dark-mode accent below a WCAG luminance floor is lightened in steps, and the panel reports that it was adjusted
- **Density**: Compact / Comfortable / Spacious — writes dsh's own content font
  size through `ctx.theme.setFontSize()`, so it agrees with the official
  Appearance control instead of shadowing it
- **Font family**: System / Monospace / Serif
- **Animation toggle**
- **Custom CSS** — override any `--dsw-*` or `--dsh-*` token
- **Import / export** themes as validated JSON. A theme exported by an older
  version carries a `density` field; it is ignored on import, since the font size
  is host state now
- **Live preview** rendering the real tokens, showing the accent value currently in effect

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-theme-studio
```

From source:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/hj01857655/dsh-theme-studio.git
cd dsh-theme-studio
npm install && npm run build
dsh plugin add link:.
```

## How it works

The plugin registers a `settings.section` slot (order 47). Preferences persist in `localStorage`.

### Mechanism

Every theme change goes through dsh's theme service:

```ts
export const inject = ['slots', 'locale', 'theme']
…
ctx.theme.overrideTokens('dsh-theme-studio', overrides)
```

`overrideTokens` stacks a partial token layer over the active theme. The service handles the rest:

- **Layers compose in order, last writer wins per token.** Two theme plugins can coexist without either silently clobbering the other's unrelated tokens.
- **Every value is a `{ light, dark }` pair.** A single value would go illegible on the other color scheme, so the API rejects one. `src/apply.ts` builds the pairs; `tests/apply.test.mjs` asserts the shape of every value it can emit.
- **The layer is disposable.** Unloading the plugin removes exactly its layer, restoring whatever the host had underneath — including a font size the user chose in the official Appearance row.

The layer is keyed by source (`dsh-theme-studio`), and re-publishing replaces it wholesale, so a shrinking override set can never leave a stale token behind.

An earlier version wrote custom properties straight onto `document.body` with `style.setProperty`. That happened to work — dsh's presenter only retracts variables it wrote itself — but it bypassed the stacking order, the paired values and the dispose story, and made every reset the plugin's own responsibility.

### Density drives the official font-size setting

`--dsh-content-font-size` is the axis the official Appearance row owns, and an
override layer sits *on top of* the theme snapshot. Overriding that token
therefore does not change the setting — it hides it, leaving the official stepper
displaying a number the UI no longer rendered.

So Density does not use an override at all. It calls
`ctx.theme.setFontSize()`, the same entry point the official control uses, and
reads back through `getTheme().fontSize`:

- The official stepper keeps showing (and setting) the same value.
- Change the size there and the matching preset highlights here; pick 15px or
  17px and nothing is highlighted, because no preset claims those.
- `--dsh-content-font-size` never appears in this plugin's override layer. The
  custom-CSS box can still set it, because that is you asking, not the plugin
deciding.
- Reset restores the size the host had before you first changed it here.

An earlier version treated the size as this plugin's own state, which produced a
control that silently disabled the official one on install (0.5.0) and then, once
the default was made inert, one that still shadowed it whenever it was used
(0.5.1).

### The preview is not a mock

It renders with the same variable names the application uses, so a wrong token looks wrong in the preview too, rather than being masked by a hardcoded fallback color.

### One validator for every way preferences get in

Preferences arrive three ways — `localStorage`, an imported JSON file, and a
hand-edited version of either. All three pass through `normalizePreferences()`,
which is the only place that validates: unknown enum values fall back to the
inert default, a `density: "comfortable"` written by 0.5.0 migrates to
`"default"`, malformed colors become `null`, and non-string/non-boolean fields
drop back to defaults. `parseTheme` intentionally keeps no whitelist of its own,
so the two entry points cannot drift apart.

## License

MIT

# dsh-context-memory

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-context-memory?color=cb3837&logo=npm&logoColor=white)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-context-memory)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-context-memory?color=cb3837)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-context-memory)
[![CI](https://github.com/hj01857655/dsh-context-memory/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/hj01857655/dsh-context-memory/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-context-memory?color=blue)](LICENSE)
[![node](https://img.shields.io/node/v/dsh-context-memory?color=339933&logo=node.js&logoColor=white)](package.json)
[![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/hj01857655/dsh-context-memory?color=yellow)](https://github.com/hj01857655/dsh-context-memory/stargazers)
[![dsh plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-plugin-4B8BBE)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

Cross-session memory for your dsh agent — remembered, recalled, and re-verified instead of assumed.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-context-memory
```

## What it does

Every session with your agent starts from nothing. What you decided yesterday, which
approach failed, the constraint you explained once — all of it is gone, and you explain
it again.

This plugin keeps it, and — unlike a note file — re-checks the parts that can be checked.

- **Remember.** A memory carries provenance: which session, which step, whether it came
  from you, the agent, or a plugin. "Why does the agent think it knows this" has an
  answer.
- **Recall.** Retrieval is ranked (token overlap, recency, verification strength) instead
  of pasting every memory into the context window. Each hit reports the breakdown of its
  score, so a ranking is never something you have to trust.
- **Forget with a reason.** A memory is superseded, never deleted. The wrong memories are
  the most valuable records in the log — they are the only thing that can explain a past
  decision.
- **Conflict detection.** Two active memories about the same subject are reported as a
  conflict. The plugin does not pick a winner; the log does not say which one is right,
  and guessing would be the unfounded assertion this plugin exists to remove.
- **Verification.** A memory whose statement has a checkable shape is compiled into a
  platform-aware guard and re-checked on demand. This is the part a notes file cannot do.

## The point

A memory is a claim about the world. Storing it makes it *available*; it does not make it
*true*. Statements like "the file README.md exists" or "config.json contains pnpm" were
true when you said them and stop being true quietly.

So `verify` turns each checkable memory back into a check and runs it:

```sh
dsh-context-memory verify
```

```
passed      4f2a9c1b8e30  the file package.json exists
violated    7d1e0a55c9f2  the file README.md contains Installation
uncheckable 2b8f31aa0456  we settled on pnpm because yarn hoisting broke the build
broken      a91c4e77b0d3  the file scripts/release.sh exists

passed 1, violated 1, broken 1, uncheckable 1
```

Four outcomes, and the distinction between them is the whole point:

| Outcome | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `passed` | The check ran and the memory holds. |
| `violated` | The check ran and the world disagrees with the memory. |
| `broken` | The check itself could not run — a typo, a missing binary. **Not** evidence about the memory. |
| `uncheckable` | No check could be compiled. The memory is still stored and recalled; it is just not verified. |

`verify` exits non-zero **only** for `violated`. A broken guard is a defect in the check,
and letting it turn a pipeline red is how a typo would get a true memory marked false —
after which you learn to ignore the output.

Nothing is ever marked as verified because it was stored, and a memory supplied by the
agent is never executed as a command: guards come from templates that only ever
interpolate quoted file paths and literal search strings.

## CLI

```sh
dsh-context-memory remember "the file package.json exists"
dsh-context-memory list
dsh-context-memory recall "how do we install"
dsh-context-memory conflicts
dsh-context-memory forget 4f2a9c1b8e30 "moved to bun"
dsh-context-memory verify        # exit 1 only on a real violation
```

## Auto capture and recall injection (0.6.0+)

The plugin hooks into `agent/pre-step` to close the loop automatically:

- **Auto capture.** When the user's message contains an explicit memory statement
  ("记住…", "remember that…"), the plugin distills and stores it before the agent sees
  the request. Each captured memory carries session provenance — which agent, which
  session — so "why does the agent think it knows this" always has an answer.

- **Recall injection.** Before each agent step, the top-5 memories whose subject
  overlaps the user's text are folded into the request as a collapsible context message
  (source `plugin/dsh-context-memory`, form `recall`). Unresolved conflicts are included
  with a warning. The injection position is right after the claimed batch — the same
  slot the host's own context plugins use.

Both features can be toggled from the panel's 「集成」 card. When auto capture is off,
memories are still stored via the CLI and service API. When recall injection is off,
the plugin still records but does not inject.

## Panel

A `Context memory` page inside Settings: active and superseded memories, verification
status per memory, conflicts, provenance, and integration toggles. The host registers
`GET /api/context-memory.panel` and rebuilds the payload from the log on every request,
so the panel shows what is on disk rather than what was in memory at startup. A headless
host has no web connection and simply skips the route.

## Layout

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `src/index.ts` | Host half — `apply(ctx)`, exposes the `contextMemory` service |
| `src/memory.ts` | Fold the log, remember, supersede, conflicts, verify |
| `src/store.ts` | Append-only `.memory/events.jsonl` |
| `src/guard.ts` | Statement → platform-aware check; run it; classify pass / violated / broken |
| `src/recall.ts` | Relevance ranking with an explainable score |
| `src/identity.ts` | Id derived from the normalised subject, so repeats fold |
| `src/cli.ts` / `src/bin.ts` | Command-line entry, usable without dsh |
| `src/routes.ts` | Panel and verify routes on the host's web connection |
| `src/client/view.tsx` | Browser half — pure rendering, statically tested in Node |
| `src/client/index.tsx` | Browser half — fetch and settings registration |

## Why the log is append-only

Current state is always a fold over the events, recomputed on each read. The
alternative — a mutable store — lets the last writer decide what was always true, and
"what did the agent believe on Tuesday, and why" becomes unanswerable. The log is the
evidence, so a torn trailing line after a crash is dropped (recoverable) while damage
anywhere else is reported rather than skipped.

## Develop

```sh
npm ci
npm run typecheck
npm run build
npm test
```

## License

MIT

# dsh-prompt-vcs

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-prompt-vcs?color=cb3837&logo=npm&logoColor=white)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-prompt-vcs)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-prompt-vcs?color=cb3837)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-prompt-vcs)
[![CI](https://github.com/hj01857655/dsh-prompt-vcs/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/hj01857655/dsh-prompt-vcs/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-prompt-vcs?color=blue)](LICENSE)
[![node](https://img.shields.io/node/v/dsh-prompt-vcs?color=339933&logo=node.js&logoColor=white)](package.json)
[![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/hj01857655/dsh-prompt-vcs?color=yellow)](https://github.com/hj01857655/dsh-prompt-vcs/stargazers)
[![dsh plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-plugin-4B8BBE)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

Every change to your agent's instructions is recorded with a diff, and any change can be undone.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-prompt-vcs
```

Or from source:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:hj01857655/dsh-prompt-vcs
```

## What it does

- **Watch the instruction surface.** `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, skill files — any file
  that shapes how the agent behaves.
- **Snapshot on change.** Unified diff + attribution (user / plugin / agent) stored in
  `.promptvcs/history.jsonl` (append-only).
- **Timeline.** `promptvcs log` shows every change: when, what file, who changed it,
  how many lines were added or removed.
- **Diff.** `promptvcs diff <hash>` shows the unified diff for a specific change —
  additions, deletions, and context lines.
- **Rollback.** `promptvcs rollback <hash>` restores a file to its state before a change.
  The rollback itself is recorded as a new change, so the timeline stays complete.
- **File stats.** Per-file change frequency and size of changes over time.
- **Panel.** Timeline with inline diffs, per-file stats, and rollback button.

## CLI

```sh
dsh-prompt-vcs log               # show change history
dsh-prompt-vcs diff <hash>       # show diff for a change
dsh-prompt-vcs rollback <hash>   # undo a change
```

## Panel

A `Prompt VCS` page inside Settings. The host registers `GET /api/prompt-vcs.panel` and
rebuilds the payload from the history log on every request. A headless host simply skips
the route.

The panel shows:

- Change timeline with inline unified diffs
- Per-file change frequency
- Attribution per change (user / plugin / agent)
- Rollback action per change

## Layout

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `src/index.ts` | Host half — `apply(ctx)`, exposes the `promptVcs` service |
| `src/vcs.ts` | Core VCS logic — record, timeline, rollback, file stats |
| `src/diff.ts` | Unified diff algorithm |
| `src/store.ts` | Append-only `.promptvcs/history.jsonl` |
| `src/cli.ts` / `src/bin.ts` | Command-line entry, usable without dsh |
| `src/routes.ts` | Panel and rollback routes on the host's web connection |
| `src/client/view.tsx` | Browser half — pure rendering |
| `src/client/index.tsx` | Browser half — fetch and settings registration |
| `src/client/locales.ts` | zh / en dictionaries |

## Develop

```sh
npm ci
npm run typecheck
npm run build
npm test
```

# 效果评测（dsh-verdict）

中文名称：**效果评测**；英文名称：**Verdict**。用于评估规则、技能或模型调整前后的效果，使用可重复的评测与证据判断是否改善。包名 `dsh-verdict`、命令 `verdict` 保持不变。

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-verdict?color=cb3837&logo=npm&logoColor=white)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-verdict)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-verdict?color=cb3837)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-verdict)
[![CI](https://github.com/hj01857655/dsh-verdict/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/hj01857655/dsh-verdict/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-verdict?color=blue)](LICENSE)
[![node](https://img.shields.io/node/v/dsh-verdict?color=339933&logo=node.js&logoColor=white)](package.json)
[![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/hj01857655/dsh-verdict?color=yellow)](https://github.com/hj01857655/dsh-verdict/stargazers)
[![dsh plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-plugin-4B8BBE)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

Measure whether a change to your dsh setup actually helped.

Register repeatable cases, run them, and diff the results before and after you change
rules, skills, model settings, or plugins. A dsh setup change usually feels like an
improvement; this plugin is what tells you whether it was one.

## Status

Published to npm as [`dsh-verdict`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-verdict).

Implemented: capture, durable store, rule promotion into `AGENTS.md`, guard compilation,
automatic re-verification (also scheduled every six hours in a resident host), skill
distillation, and the settings page. Covered by unit tests against a real filesystem
(`npm test`), including static renders of the panel. CI runs on Ubuntu and Windows.

Verified on real hardware: the plugin loads inside dsh, the host route
`GET /api/verdict.panel` serves the panel payload, and the browser half registers a
"Verdict" page in Settings without errors.

## What it does

```js
ctx.verdict.learn('never commit the file secrets.env')
// -> rule captured, guard compiled for this platform, written into AGENTS.md
//    behind <!-- verdict:<id> -->, and now re-checked on demand

ctx.verdict.check()
// -> { passed, violated, broken, exitCode }
//    exitCode is 1 only for real violations — a guard that cannot run is
//    reported separately and never turns a pipeline red
```

A rule is only promoted if it has an executable check. A rule whose check stops holding
is reported; a rule that keeps failing is demoted to `ineffective` after three **distinct**
violation episodes — not three runs, so a long-lived failure cannot inflate the count.

The compiler knows a few sentence shapes — file existence, forbidden files, forbidden
root globs ("no *.pem files"), and required file contents ("the file README.md must
mention install") — and refuses any sentence it cannot express faithfully on the current
platform, leaving it a candidate rather than emitting an approximate command.

## Install

From npm (recommended — the tarball ships pre-built `lib/`):

```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-verdict --profile web
```

Or pin an exact version:

```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-verdict@0.5.1 --profile web
```

For local development without publishing:

```sh
dsh plugin add link:/path/to/dsh-verdict --profile web
```

The plugin ships a `cordis.patch.yml`, so the profile registers it on install — there is
nothing to insert by hand. GitHub source installs will not work directly because `lib/`
is gitignored and dsh forbids install-time build scripts; use npm or `link:` instead.

## CLI

The same modules are reachable without booting dsh, so the plugin's claims can be
checked independently and `check` can run in CI:

```sh
verdict learn "never commit the file .env"    # capture + compile a guard + promote
verdict check                                 # exit 1 on real violations, 0 otherwise
verdict list
verdict recall "env"
verdict session --intent "verify a change" --step "run tests" --step "commit"
verdict skills --write
verdict panel                     # the panel's view of the project
verdict diff before ; verdict diff after ; verdict diff
                                  # did that change help? answered from two snapshots
verdict doctor                    # check this package against dsh's plugin rules
verdict inventory --audit         # installed plugins, and what would stop them loading
```

`verdict check` is the CI-relevant one: it exits non-zero for a genuine violation and
stays zero when the only problem is a guard that cannot run, so a typo in a guard can
never turn a pipeline red on its own.

`verdict doctor` covers everything about loading that is static — manifest, build output,
patch id agreement, peer placement, lifecycle scripts — so the one thing left for a real
dsh install is the loader itself.

## Web panel

The plugin also ships a browser half (`exports["./client"]`). It registers a
`settings.section` slot — a "Verdict" page inside Settings — and reads the panel
from `GET /api/verdict.panel`, which the host half registers on the web
connection when one exists. Hosts without a web client simply skip it.

The page draws only what the data supports: a rule shows "guard passed" because
a guard ran and passed, never because it was promoted, and a before/after
comparison without both snapshots states that instead of an improvement. Skill
candidates distilled from repeated successes are listed with a write action
(`POST /api/verdict.skills.write`); the response carries whether the written
skill's guard actually runs.

`scripts/bundle-client.mjs` replicates the loader's lazy-CJS factory artifact
(banner, intro vars, footer, `react` left external to the platform module
table). The bundle is `lib/verdict.web.js` — deliberately not `lib/client.js`,
which is the compiled host module `src/client.ts`.

## Layout

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `src/index.ts` | Host half — `apply(ctx)`, exposes the `verdict` service |
| `src/identity.ts` | Rule id derived from text, so repeats collapse into one rule |
| `src/store.ts` | Durable `.verdict/ledger.json`; atomic writes |
| `src/guard.ts` | Rule → shell command; run it; classify pass / violated / broken |
| `src/promote.ts` | Write rule into `AGENTS.md` behind a marker; verify its presence |
| `src/check.ts` | Verification pass, episode-based recurrence, exit code |
| `src/pipeline.ts` | `learn`: capture → compile → promote |
| `src/session.ts` | Append-only session log; what actually happened |
| `src/skills.ts` | Distil repeated successes into a skill (M6) |
| `src/cli.ts` / `src/bin.ts` | Command-line entry, usable without dsh |
| `src/routes.ts` | `GET /api/verdict.panel` and `POST /api/verdict.skills.write` on the host's web connection |
| `src/verdict-view.ts` | Payload → view model, shared by host route and browser half |
| `src/schedule.ts` | The six-hour re-check report line for resident hosts |
| `src/client/index.tsx` | Browser half — panel state, fetch, registration |
| `src/client/view.tsx` | Browser half — pure rendering, statically tested in Node |
| `scripts/bundle-client.mjs` | esbuild bundle in the loader's factory format |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Profile registration (`insert` id `dsh-verdict`) |
| `package.json` | Package manifest; host packages stay in `peerDependencies` |

## Payloads must be peers

dsh reserves certain packages for the host. Copying one into this plugin's own
`dependencies` produces a nested or aliased copy, which the profile validation rejects.
So `@deepseek-ai/cordis` and every `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` package this plugin uses belong in
`peerDependencies` (plus `devDependencies` for local typechecking), never in
`dependencies`.

## No lifecycle scripts

Desktop rejects plugins whose dependencies carry install lifecycle scripts unless the
package is in the desktop project's reviewed `allowBuilds` policy. This plugin therefore
does no work at install time — everything happens in `apply`.

## Develop

```sh
npm ci
npm run typecheck
npm run build
npm test
node tests/smoke.mjs   # end-to-end walkthrough against temp dirs
```

plugins.description: 重新回答 · Answer again — DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件：助手消息动作条上的「重新回答」按钮，先把这一轮的旧回答退出模型上下文，再把该轮的用户提问重新提交给同一个会话。 A DSH plugin that re-answers a turn after dropping the previous answer from the model context.
plugins.readme_text:
# 重新回答 · dsh-session-retry

[中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)

> 在助手消息的动作条上加一个 **重新回答** 按钮：把该轮回答对应的用户提问重新提交给
> **同一个会话**，并**先让这一轮的旧回答退出模型上下文** —— 重答时模型看不到自己上一次
> 在这一轮里答了什么（日志与界面上的历史消息不动）。

按钮落在复制与分支之间（`conversation.chat.assistant-actions`，`order: 20`），样子与原生动作条按钮一致：方形图标按钮、悬停出深色提示气泡、与那条动作条一起悬停/聚焦显隐（`data-clock=end` 那一轮尺寸跟着原生图标走）。图标与提示气泡都是插件自带的：插件实践要求第三方插件的浏览器半边不 `require` Harness 客户端包，所以这里只 `require('react')`。

- 行 id：`session-retry`
- 位置：助手消息动作条（`conversation.chat.assistant-actions`）
- 依赖：无（宿主半边注入 `connection` 与 `agents`，浏览器半边只依赖 `react`）

## 它做什么

- **宿主半边**（[index.js](index.js)）在共享的 `/api` 通道上注册两条路由：

  ```
  POST /api/session-retry/context      { sessionId }                 （只读）
    → { ok, sessionId, latestTurn, cached, anchors: [
          { messageId, turn, text, promptCount, omittedParts, promptSeq, anchorSeq } ] }

  POST /api/session-retry/regenerate   { sessionId, messageId }      （登记改写）
    → { ok, turn, promptSeq, runs, shadowed, kept, eventSeqs, deferred: true }
  ```

  前者一遍扫过整条会话日志，把「动作条挂在哪条助手消息上」与「该轮的用户提问」配对，结果按会话缓存 1.5 秒。后者只认**活会话**：从 `sessions.get(id)` 拿会话、用 `snapshotEvents()` 现场重算锚点（与 `/context` 同一套 `retryTargets` 规则），再把该轮的可见面节点替换成空节点 —— 但**不在点按钮的当场写**，而是登记一份影子计划，等下一次请求真的打开一个步骤时补写（原因见下一节）。

- **浏览器半边**（[client.js](client.js)）按会话注册一个动作条条目：取一次上面的表，每条动作条拿自己的 `messageId` 查表 —— 命中就可点，没命中就置灰并说明原因。点击后**先** POST `/regenerate`，**成功才**用 `session.prompt([{ type: 'text', text }], 'queue')` 提交提问（与 `ui-conversation` 的 `conversation.send` 走同一条路径）—— 两步都成了才提示「已重新回答（旧回答已退出上下文…）」；改写没成就只转述原因、不提交，否则等于在旧回答还在上下文时把提问问第二遍。

## 旧回答是怎么消失的

改写的是**可见面（surface）**，不是日志：会话记录、界面上的历史消息、标题与统计都原样保留，只有送给模型的消息列表少掉这一段 —— 模型能看到什么由 `dsh-session` 的 surface 折叠与 `deriveMessages()` 决定。

用法是 surface 自己的替换通道：追加一条 `system/message` 事件，带 `surfaceOp: { op: 'replace', startSeq, endSeq }` 与 `sourceEventSeqs`（被遮蔽节点必须列全，应用会严格校验）。载体必须是**空 system 节点**：应用自己的规则是「空 system/developer 节点保留可见面位置但不产生线缆消息」（`dsh-session` 的 `deriveEventMessage`），而空 `user/message` 会作为一条空 user 消息真的发出去。

**写这条事件的时机有硬约束**：`system/message` 属于 V4 的「步骤事件」，校验要求它的 `turn`/`step` 必须等于**当前打开的**那一对（`dsh-session-format-v3-to-v4` 的 `STEP_EVENT_TYPES` + `requireStep`）。点按钮时会话是**空闲**的 —— 上一轮已经 `turn/end`、下一轮还没 `turn/start`，没有任何打开的步骤 —— 此刻带着上一轮的 `turn`/`step` 写进去，日志当场就坏：

```
SessionFormatError: system/message does not match an open turn and step
→ stored log is corrupt ...
```

所以 `/regenerate` 只**登记**影子计划（`deferred: true`，可见面当场不动），等客户端提交的提问真的打开一个步骤时，在 `agent/request` 钩子里用**当时打开的 turn/step** 补写。这个位置既合法（步骤确实开着），又足够早 —— `dsh-agent-loop` 的 `step()` 先 `step/start`，然后 `prepareRequest`→`agent/request`（hook），最后才 `buildRequest`→`deriveMessages()`，所以用户这一次请求就已经看不见旧回答了。会话在补写前被关掉也没事：计划带 TTL，过期即弃，日志里什么都没写过。

**影子范围怎么算**：每个可见面节点取一个「内容区间终点」—— 追加型节点是自己本身就是新内容，终点是它自己的 seq；替换型节点继承被替换段的位置（压缩摘要就是这样占住早期位置的），终点是被替换段的末端。终点早于本轮提问的节点属于「提问之前的记忆」（例如提问前产生的压缩摘要），**保留**；终点不早于提问的节点都是这一轮的产物，**影掉**。要影的节点在可见面里未必连续，所以按可见面下标切成连续段，一段一次 append（每段留一个空节点占位）。这段判定是纯函数 `shadowPlan()`，真实日志与合成事件都能直接喂进去测。

## 判定规则（与界面严格对齐）

动作条由 `ui-chat` 的轮次尾部渲染：每轮一条，挂在**该轮最后一个产出文本的步骤**里**最后一条** `assistant/message` 上（`closing = finalized.findLast(hasText)`）。本插件的锚点就是这条消息，所以：

- 该轮没有产出文本的步骤（例如中途被打断）→ 界面本来就不渲染动作条，自然也没有按钮；
- 该轮的提问 = `turn/start` 之后、锚点之前的人工消息（`source.kind === 'user'`）。注入的上下文（`time-context`、`skill-catalog`、插件通知）与压缩检查点都不是提问；替换操作（`surfaceOp` 为对象，压缩复写旧消息）也不是追加，不参与判定。

**一轮里不止一句提问**：用户在模型回答途中发话（steering / 排队）时，那句话会被接进同一个轮次。此时按顺序把该轮全部提问**合并成一段**重发 —— 只挑其中一句会丢掉另一句，合并则既不丢内容也只提交一次。提示语会如实写明「合并 N 条提问」。

## 刻意做出的取舍

- **影掉而不是删除**：宿主没有截断历史或回滚轮次的公开接口，已经写进日志的事件也删不掉，所以这是「让模型看不见」。想要真正另起一段历史，用动作条上的**分支**按钮（另开会话）。
- **重答更早的轮次 = 回退到那一轮重来**：影子范围从该轮提问起一直覆盖到可见面末尾，所以那一轮之后的轮次也会退出上下文（否则模型会带着「后面已经发生的事」去答前面那轮）。
- **只服务活会话**：`/regenerate` 要拿到内存里的会话对象才能改写；会话不在应用里打开时返回 `NOT_LIVE`。会话正在回答时返回 `RUNNING` —— 边答边改可见面属于压缩那种受控场景，这里不做（提示语会直接说「先停止再重新回答」）。
- **非文字内容不重发**：只重发文字块；原消息里的图片、附件只计数，并在提示语里说明「N 个非文字内容没有重发」。
- **一次请求答完整条会话**：动作条是每轮一条，一场长会话有几十条同时挂在页面上；逐条询问就是几十趟日志回放。所以客户端按会话取一次表，同一提交里挂载的动作条共用一趟请求（后挂载的动作条会补一趟，保证看到的是它挂载之后的判定）。

## 工程约束

- **浏览器半边只依赖 `react`**：`dsh.client.inject` 只声明 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat`（插槽的属主），`immediately: true` 让前端在启动时就预取这个包。图标（`RefreshIcon`，几何照抄原生刷新图标）与提示气泡（纯 CSS 显隐，不 portal、不写 `document.body`）都在 [client.js](client.js) 里自带。
- **宿主半边注入 `connection` 与 `agents`**：`agents` 是 `agent/request` 钩子（补写那一步）必需的；`sessionQuery` 与 `sessions` 都不注入，缺失时按不可用降级回答 —— 没挂 `sessionQuery` 的组合里 `/context` 答 `UNAVAILABLE`，没挂 `sessions` 的组合里 `/regenerate` 也答 `UNAVAILABLE`，都不会把插件拖垮。
- **空节点写在打开的步骤里**：补写只发生在 `agent/request`（步骤已打开、消息还没装配），所以空节点的 `turn`/`step` 一定等于当时打开的那一对，日志不会被写坏；没有打开的步骤时（例如钩子被别的组合提前调用）就什么也不写，计划留到下一步。

## 安装

本插件是一个标准 DSH bundle：`package.json` 里声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch` 与 `dsh.client`，装进任何 profile 都走同一条路。先装好 DSH 桌面端（[deepseek.com/download](https://www.deepseek.com/download/)），然后下面任选一种。

### 方式一 · 在 DSH 桌面端里装（推荐）

1. 侧栏点 **插件** → **添加插件**（Add plugin）；
2. 在输入框里填下面任意一种 spec：
   - 本仓库地址：`https://github.com/linanbuan/dsh-session-retry`
   - 本仓库的压缩包链接（GitHub 页面的 `Source code (zip)`）
   - 已经克隆到本机的**目录绝对路径**
   - 包名（若将来发布到 npm）
3. 点 **安装**：Harness 先读出这个 spec 指向什么（包名、简介、版本），确认后开始装；
4. 装完点 **立即启用**。

整个安装由 Harness 自己的插件管理器完成：把这个包写进当前 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`，并挂上宿主半边。**桌面端装插件不需要命令行，也不需要手改 profile 文件。**

### 方式二 · 让 Agent 自己装

把仓库地址或本机目录直接交给任意会话里的 Agent，它会调用 `plugin_manager` 工具（`action: install_bundle`）走同一条路。这是官方给第三方插件推荐的安装方式。

### 方式三 · 命令行

装了 dsh CLI 的机器上：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile 名> add <spec>
```

`<spec>` 与方式一相同（包名、Git 地址、压缩包链接或本地路径）；参数以 `dsh plugin --help` 的实际输出为准。

### 方式四 · 手工装进某个 profile（排障用，不推荐）

profile 目录默认在 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile 名>`。把包放进去，并在 profile 自己的 `package.json` 里登记两处：

```json
"dependencies": { "@local/dsh-session-retry": "link:<本目录绝对路径>" },
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ "…", "@local/dsh-session-retry" ] } }
```

手改 profile 文件要过权限审批，写坏会让 Harness 起不来，所以正常安装请走前面三种。

**一个坑**：在 WSL 里 `ln -s` 出来的链接是 Linux 符号链接，Windows 侧跑的 Electron 解析不了它，插件页会报 `dsh: cannot resolve profile bundle "@local/dsh-session-retry"`。要真链接就让 Windows 侧的 pnpm 去建（方式一/二），否则就用目录副本。

## 装上之后

激活与**改完代码之后怎么让它生效**是两件事：

1. 侧栏 **插件** → 找到 `@local/dsh-session-retry`；
2. 点那一行的开关 **停用再启用**（一次热挂载）；
3. 组件状态从「已关闭」变「运行中」＝宿主半边挂在启动图里了；
4. 浏览器半边会跟着 `/plugins/events` 的 graph 帧重新拉取 `client.js`，**不用刷新页面**。

**但宿主半边改了代码必须重启应用。** cordis 的插件加载器用裸 `import()` 加载宿主模块，Node 的 ESM 缓存按文件 URL 命中，停用再启用只会重跑**缓存里那份旧模块**的 `apply()` —— 新注册的路由不会出现。表现是：按钮是新版本，点下去却提示「宿主那半还是旧版本（404），重启应用后再试」（客户端把这条 404 专门翻译成能照着做的一句话）。所以：

- 只改 [client.js](client.js)：热挂载即可，页面不用刷新；
- 改了 [index.js](index.js) 或 [package.json](package.json)：**重启应用**。

### 停用 / 卸载

```yaml
- id: session-retry
  disabled: true
```

或者直接点插件页那一行的开关；彻底移除用插件页 → 这个包 → **卸载**。

## 注意事项

1. **本插件不是官方插件**：与 DeepSeek AI 无任何关联，不提供服务承诺。它依赖 DSH 内部的 surface 折叠与步骤事件契约，**这些不是稳定 API**：Harness 升级后按钮可能置灰或改写失败，此时插件只转述原因、不提交任何东西，不会破坏会话日志。
2. **它会改写当前会话的可见面**：这是插件的全部目的，但它确实往会话里追加了事件（`system/message` + `surfaceOp`）。原始日志与界面历史不动，可随时用「分支」另开会话保留原样。**请勿在需要严格留证的一次性会话里使用**。
3. **0.3.0 之前写过坏日志**：早期版本在会话空闲时当场追写步骤事件，会被 V4 校验器拒绝（`system/message does not match an open turn and step`），受影响的会话日志需要单独修复；1.0.0 起改为「登记影子计划 + 在打开的步骤里补写」，不再有这个问题。若你手上是旧版本，请升级。
4. **运行中的会话不能重答**：返回 `RUNNING`，提示语会说「先停止再重新回答」。
5. **非文字内容不重发**：图片与附件只计数、不重新提交，提示语会写明数量。
6. **安装后不会自动更新**：官方插件管理器目前不支持自动更新，升级＝先卸载再装新版；替换已安装的包之后宿主半边要重启应用。
7. **兼容性**：在 DSH 0.1.7-rc.2（Windows 桌面端）上开发与验证。宿主半边注入 `connection` 与 `agents`（后者供 `agent/request` 钩子用），`sessionQuery` / `sessions` 缺失时降级为 `UNAVAILABLE` 而不是崩溃。
8. **隐私**：插件不联网、无遥测。它在宿主侧读会话日志与内存中的会话对象，浏览器半边只拿到这一轮要用的锚点表（消息 id、轮次、提问文本）。
9. **权限**：插件自身不申请任何额外权限；安装时由 Harness 的插件管理器走它自己的审批流程。
10. **本仓库的隐私**：仓库内不含任何密钥、凭据、账号标识、会话日志或本机路径（文档里的路径一律是 `~/.dsh/...` 形式或 `<占位符>`）。

## 测试

```bash
node test/retry-targets.mjs      # 判定与影子范围的单元测试（合成事件，零依赖）
node test/client-contract.mjs    # 浏览器半边在替身环境里的契约测试（零依赖）
```

`retry-targets` 覆盖锚点判定与影子范围：一轮一会话、多轮取最大轮次、一轮多句提问合并计数、提问只有非文字内容时不给锚点、该轮没有产出文本的步骤时不给锚点、注入上下文与插件通知不算提问、锚点之后的提问不算本轮、空日志/畸形事件/缺 `turn/end` 安全降级、影子范围的边界与不连续切段。

`client-contract` 按宿主客户端的加载契约搭一个最小替身（`window.__ModuleLoader__` + react + slots/locale/sessions 服务），驱动真模块走完「注册 → 挂载 → 取上下文 → 点击提交 → 提示语」的全过程。替身**故意不提供任何 Harness 客户端包** —— 一旦 `client.js` 又去 `require` 一个，就在那里当场失败。它验证的是模块自己的逻辑与注册形状；「按钮在真实界面里的位置与样式」不在它能证明的范围内。

真机实证（用应用自己的 `Session` 实现与真实会话日志跑端到端，含「补写出来的日志能被 V4 校验器读回来」这条）不在本仓库内，属于本机验证材料。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-paid-poop 带薪拉屎

[![DeepSeek Harness plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-dsh--plugin-blue)](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)

> 带薪拉屎 / 带薪如厕 / Paid Poop / paid toilet break timer —— 一个 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：悬浮按钮记录每次拉屎时长，按月薪、单双休、法定节假日自动算出这次带薪拉屎赚了多少钱。

**关键词**：带薪拉屎 · 带薪如厕 · 带薪蹲坑 · 摸鱼 · 带薪拉屎计算器 · 上班如厕计时 · paid poop · paid toilet break · salary timer · work shirk · bathroom break earnings · DeepSeek Harness · dsh plugin · dsh 插件

## 功能一览

- **悬浮球计时**：点一下开始、再点一下结束并结算；支持拖拽移位（位置记忆）与自定义尺寸（36–96px）。
- **真实薪酬结算**：月薪 ÷ 当月工作日 ÷ 日工时，跨午休自动扣减，仅工作时段计薪（可关），支持双休 / 单休 / 大小周。
- **法定节假日与调休**：内置 2025、2026 年国务院办公厅官方放假调休表，节假日不计薪、补班日照常计薪；可自定义补班/放假日（年假、事假）。
- **统计面板**：今日/本月次数、总收益、平均时长、单次最高、月薪回本率、每日收益柱状图、历史记录、手动补记。
- **拉屎提醒**：设定提醒时刻（默认 10:30 / 15:30），面板弹窗 + 可选浏览器系统通知。
- **中英双语**、零构建纯 JS、数据全部存浏览器 localStorage（不上传、不落盘）。

## 安装

### 方式一：本地目录安装（推荐开发者）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add link:<本仓库绝对路径>
```

或在 DSH 会话里让 Agent 用 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle` 传本仓库绝对路径。安装后刷新 `http://127.0.0.1:3080` 即可在右下角看到悬浮球。

### 方式二：从 awesome 列表安装

本插件已提交至 [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) 收录列表（`fun` 分类），可通过 [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) 等插件市场一键安装。

## 用法

- **悬浮球**：空闲时显示当日累计收益，点击开始计时；计时中显示实时金额与脉冲外圈，再点一下结束并结算。**按住可拖动到任意位置**（拖 5px 内算点击，位置自动记忆，下次打开仍在原处）。**尺寸可在设置 Tab 调整**（36–96px 滑杆，实时生效）。
- **面板**：点悬浮球右上角的 ☰ 展开四个 Tab——今日（次数/总时长/总收益/平均/非带薪 + 明细）、本月（日均次数/最长/单次最高/月薪回本率 + 每日收益柱状图）、记录（按日分组、逐条删除、手动补记）、设置。
- **提醒**：到达提醒时刻时面板弹 toast + 悬浮球脉冲；可选开启浏览器系统通知（首次打开开关时申请权限）。

## 计算口径

```
秒薪 = 月薪 ÷ 当月工作日数（或固定 21.75）÷ 每日工时秒数
每日工时 = (下班 − 上班) − (午休，若启用)
```

- 工作制：双休（周一~五）/ 单休（周一~六）/ 大小周（按基准周推算单双休周）。
- **法定节假日与调休**：内置 2025、2026 年国务院办公厅官方放假/调休表（国办发明电〔2024〕12号、〔2025〕7号）——法定假日照常的工作日不计薪，周末补班日照常计薪；未收录年份自动回退纯星期判定，并在设置页提示。
- **自定义日期**：设置里可添加「补班日」（如公司调休）与「放假日」（年假、事假等），优先级高于星期判定与内置年表。
- 计薪区间：仅工作时段（可关闭，关闭后按全天计薪）；跨午休自动扣除重叠部分。
- 非工作日 / 非工作时段的记录照常落库但收益为 0（标注原因）。
- 跨天的记录归属**开始日**；短于 3 秒视为误触不记录；超过 4 小时结算前需确认。
- 不扣五险一金，薪资按税前口径；官方年表按年更新（新年份公告发布后更新插件，或用自定义日期临时补充）。

## 数据与隐私

- 全部数据存在**浏览器 localStorage**，键 `dshPaidPoop.v1`，不上传、不落 Host。
- 记录保留最近 730 天；设置页可**导出 JSON 备份**、**清空数据**。
- 存储损坏时自动备份到 `dshPaidPoop.v1.corrupt` 并按默认值重建；隐私模式下降级为内存态并提示。

## 清空方式

设置 Tab → 清空数据（二次确认）；或在浏览器控制台执行 `localStorage.removeItem('dshPaidPoop.v1')`。

# dsh-chat

面向 DSH 的去中心化 AI 社交与创作网络。按 `dsh-chat_product_plan (1).md`（V2.0）实现，
范围是**规划的阶段 0 + 阶段 1 核心骨架**：一个真正能安装、能跑、能被外部验证的 DSH 插件。

> 一句话：让每一次 AI 对话，都可以被分享、讨论和复现。
>
> 本版本已经做到的：**装上之后，一个字节都不会离开这台机器**，直到你在界面上对某一条会话
> 显式开启分享或直播。

---

## 当前状态

| 项 | 状态 |
|---|---|
| 已安装到的 profile | `desktop`（`plugin_manager install_bundle`，`application: applied`） |
| 目标 DSH 版本 | `0.2.0-rc.2`（`peerDependencies` 声明 `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`） |
| 测试总数 | **314 项全部通过**（162 单元/集成/渲染/RPC + 125 网络 + 10 Host 加载冒烟 + 17 观众间分发） |
| 真实环境验证 | 已通过：外部独立进程在 **8ms** 内被发现、完成双向 Ed25519 握手并双向交换签名信封（见下） |
| 网络测试 | **101 项全通过**：链路质量 13 · 拓扑 8 · 虚拟互联网 23（NAT/打洞/防火墙/真实丢包）· 中继 21 · **打洞与信誉 36** |
| 中继与加密 | 公网节点可作中继；私聊**端到端加密**（X25519+AES-GCM），中继**在协议层解不开**，明文私聊被拒转 |
| 打洞 | 交换候选 + 双方同时拨号；**全锥/受限锥形可打通，对称 NAT 直接跳过**并如实标注 NAT 类型 |
| 中继选择与信誉 | 多中继按"手动指定 > 目标亲和 > 本地成功率 > 负载"打分；**他人证明压不过本地实测**（防女巫）；贡献账本不用代币 |
| 可达性自动识别 | 分层取证：本地地址分类 → 中继观察 → **入站实证（唯一判据）**。**不靠「比对公网 IP」** —— 那两件事经常不一致 |
| 观众间分发 | 直播时已收到的观众帮同房间转发。实测发布者上行 **-80%**（全员可达）／**-18%**（仅 20% 可达） |
| 未实现 | 群聊、离线消息托管、**UDP 传输层**（TCP 打洞受限于同时打开，UDP 才是稳妥解法）、IPFS/内容寻址分发、区块链存证 |

诚实边界写在 [`docs/plan-coverage.md`](docs/plan-coverage.md)：规划里的每一条要求都逐项标了
「已实现 / 部分实现 / 未实现」，没有含糊带过。

---

## 它做了什么

### 会话分享（规划 §6）
在会话页面点「分享会话」，依次选择访问范围、外发粒度、内容类型，**必须看过预览**才能发布。
发布的分享对象带：

- 唯一内容标识（`id` = 对「除 id 与 sig 之外全部字段」的内容哈希）
- Merkle 根（逐条内容哈希构成，任何一条被改动都会失配）
- 作者 Ed25519 签名
- 访问策略（范围 / 粒度 / 是否可复制 / 有效期）
- 一张 `disclosure` 说明表，明说自己包含什么、不包含什么

校验时**完整性与真实性是两个独立结论**，不合并成一个布尔值——规划 §6.4 特意写了
「内容哈希只能证明数据一致性，不能证明内容一定真实」。界面上也照这句话显示。

### 会话直播（规划 §7）
主播侧：开播 / 暂停 / 恢复 / 结束 / 发布回放。观众侧：按 `seq` 补拉、去重、检测空洞。
每条直播事件都带签名，事件类型与规划 §7.4 逐条对应
（`session_started` / `message_added` / `artifact_published` / `message_updated` /
`stream_paused` / `stream_resumed` / `session_ended`）。

两个容易被做错的地方，这里是这么处理的：

- **暂停 ≠ 结束**。暂停只停止序号推进，本地 DSH 会话继续跑；恢复不会产生第二个直播间。
- **事件序号只由主播推进**，观众的聊天走另一条通道，不污染事实序列。

### 节点与隐私（规划 §2.4、§9、§12）
- 首次启动生成 Ed25519 身份，私钥写在 `~/.dsh/dsh-chat/identity.json`（权限 `0600`），
  不上传、不记日志、不进入任何外发结构。
- **同意机制**：授权是「会话 × 内容类型 × 范围 × 有效期」四元组，默认拒绝，
  **不跨进程继承**（重启后回到未授权）。开播/分享前必须过预览，这是硬前置——
  Host 侧会拒绝没有 `previewed` 标记的请求，绕过界面直接调 RPC 也一样。
- **出站脱敏**：路径收敛、密钥形态识别、自定义关键词与正则。契约对齐官方
  `dsh-session-telemetry` 的 waterfall——**任一规则抛错就 fail-closed 扣下整条记录**，
  而不是"脱敏失败就原样发出去"。
- **一键暂停所有贡献**：撤销全部授权 + 结束所有直播间。

### 节点网络（规划 §9.3、§10）
- 传输层是**可替换的接口**（`NodeTransport`），当前实现 `LanTransport`：
  自研 RFC6455 WebSocket + UDP 信标发现 + 邀请码 + 双向 Ed25519 握手。
- 规划 §18.2 第 4 条要求「先实测再选型」，所以这里没有一上来引 libp2p/WebRTC；
  换实现时上层代码不需要改。
- 信封带版本、id（去重）、seq（补洞）、时间戳（时钟偏差窗口）与签名。

### 插件目录（规划 §4）
可验证清单 + 四维结构化评分（功能 / 易用 / 稳定 / 文档）。本地已安装插件进入目录时
一律标 `verified: false`——它们来自文件系统，**没有签名可验**。
聚合结果里明确带 `sybilResistance: 'none'`，不给用户"这个分数已经反过刷"的错觉。

---

## 安装到 DSH

从 GitHub 获取源码：

```
git clone https://github.com/z8313568/dsh-chat.git
cd dsh-chat
npm install
npm run build     # 生成 lib/（Host ESM + Client CJS），构建产物不入库
```

再把它装进 DSH，把下面的 `/绝对路径/dsh-chat` 换成克隆下来的目录。

已经装好了。重新安装或换 profile：

```
plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle", target: "/绝对路径/dsh-chat" }
```

不要手改 profile 的 `package.json` 或 `cordis.patch.yml`——`install_bundle` 会做这些，
手改需要额外审批。本插件的 `cordis.patch.yml` 只是它自己的加载补丁：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-chat
      name: dsh-chat
```

### 改完代码之后要做什么

| 改了哪里 | 要做什么 |
|---|---|
| `src/client/**`（界面） | Client bundle 的 HMR 会按产物指纹自动换掉，**刷新页面**即可 |
| `src/host/**`（Host 半体） | **必须重启 DSH**。Host 插件是 Node ESM 模块，进程内只会加载一次，重新 `install_bundle` 也不会重载它 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 config | 补丁层是热重载的（约 1 秒） |

⚠️ 这条很实际：本次交付末尾修掉了一个「界面所有操作都报未知方法」的 RPC bug，
**它在重启 DSH 之前不会生效** —— 运行中的进程里还是旧代码。

### 配置

在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的条目下加 `config:` 段（默认值见 `src/host/config.js`）：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-chat
      name: dsh-chat
      config:
        identity:
          nickname: 我的节点
        privacy:
          defaultSharingMode: disabled     # disabled | minimal | standard | full
          redaction:
            keywords: ["内部代号"]
            patterns: ["SECRET-\\d+"]
        discovery:
          enabled: true
          beaconPort: 47899
        listen:
          host: 127.0.0.1                  # 改成局域网地址才会向局域网广播
          port: 0
```

⚠️ 本版本**没有导出 `Config` schema**，所以设置页的 Plugins 面板里不会出现配置表单
（`Config.listConfigs` 显示 `status: absent`）。配置只能通过补丁下发，改完需要重启 DSH。

### 卸载

```
plugin_manager { action: "set_bundle", target: "dsh-chat", enabled: false }
```

数据目录 `~/.dsh/dsh-chat/` 不会被自动删除，需要手动清理（里面是你的身份私钥，
删之前请确认已备份）。

---

## 网络测试

"不同网络下能不能连上、数据对不对"有两层，分别有专门的测试环境：

```sh
npm run test:network    # 43 项：链路质量 13 + 拓扑 8 + 虚拟互联网 22
npm run test:virtual    # 只跑 NAT / 防火墙 / 真实丢包那 22 项
npm run lab -- serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 47800     # 真实设备实验台（一台监听）
npm run lab -- dial 192.168.3.90:47800 --count 200    # 另一台拨号压测
npm run lab -- probe --seconds 20                     # 只做发现探测
```

- **链路质量**：两个真实节点之间夹一个 TCP 故障注入代理，测延迟、抖动、黑洞、RST、
  半关闭、带宽限制、逐字节分片、字节损坏、8 节点并发、8 轮断连重连。
- **网络拓扑**：换地址而不是换质量 —— 回环 IPv4、回环 IPv6、真实局域网网卡、
  双栈跨地址族、局域网 UDP 信标发现。
- **虚拟互联网**：用户态搭出多子网 + NAT + 防火墙，测"**谁能连谁**"——
  无映射被拒、端口映射可行、**打洞（全锥形）可行、对称 NAT 不可行**；
  外加一条自实现的可靠 UDP 链路，让**真实丢包**（20%/50%/100%）对上层可见。

完整的矩阵、实测数据、以及**仍然测不了、必须用真实设备**的场景清单，见
[`docs/network-testing.md`](docs/network-testing.md)。

中继与端到端加密的设计、隐私边界、以及"公网节点怎么知道自己真的可达"，见
[`docs/relay.md`](docs/relay.md)。

打洞、多中继选择、信誉与不使用代币的贡献记账，见
[`docs/punch-and-incentives.md`](docs/punch-and-incentives.md)。

"我怎么知道自己是公网节点"——为什么不能用比对公网 IP 的办法、以及分层取证方案，见
[`docs/reachability-detection.md`](docs/reachability-detection.md)。

> 那一节比"通过"更重要：NAT 穿透、跨运营商时延、移动网络抖动、企业防火墙、
> 纯 IPv4↔纯 IPv6 —— 这些**本次都没有验证**，并给出了各自的测试方法。

## 贡献默认值

规划 §9.2 的那句「普通用户无需为了使用好友、会话查看等基础功能而贡献存储或带宽」
是一条**底线**（贡献不能成为使用基础功能的前提），**不是"默认不贡献"**。

本项目把贡献分成两类，默认值不同：

| | 会话内分发（直播 swarm） | 对陌生人的中继 |
|---|---|---|
| 你和它的关系 | 你**已经**在看这场直播、已经收到数据 | 陌生人需要连到你 |
| 额外下载 | **零** | 零，但占上行 |
| 默认 | **开** | **auto**（实测可达 + 非计费网络 + 接电源 + 未超预算） |

```yaml
contribution:
  mode: auto                      # off | auto | on
  swarm:
    enabled: true                 # 会话内分发，默认开
    minRoomSize: 4                # 人少时发布者直发更简单
    maxServees: 4
    maxServeBytesPerMinute: 33554432
  maxCacheBytes: 536870912        # 公开内容缓存 512 MB
  onlyOnPower: true
  onlyOnUnmetered: true
  monthlyUploadBudgetBytes: 21474836480
```

**为什么不能"所有节点都贡献"**：三个理由，一个比一个硬 ——
① **技术上也做不到**：NAT 后面且无端口映射时入站必然失败，强制贡献等于让节点对外宣称一个不存在的能力，
别人的消息发进去石沉大海，**比不贡献更糟**；
② **代价落在用户身上**：默认开 = 用陌生人的移动流量和电池做好事；
③ **规划自己就反对**：§9.2 要求"一键暂停"、"仅在非计费网络时运行"、缓存档位含 0。

完整论证与实测数据见 [`docs/contribution-defaults.md`](docs/contribution-defaults.md)。

## 排查插件加载问题

插件加载失败可能是**完全静默**的：Cordis 的 `inject` 是硬依赖，只要有一个服务没就绪，
`apply()` 就永远不会被调用，不报错也不写日志。界面上只显示"无法访问 Host 半体"。

所以 `apply()` 会把启动结论写到数据目录的 `boot.json`：

```sh
cat ~/.dsh/dsh-chat/boot.json
```

| phase | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `apply-called` | `apply` 已进入。**只有这一条** → 后续步骤中途失败 |
| `rpc-mounted` | RPC 路由挂上了（客户端能通信的前提） |
| `apply-completed` | 全部执行完毕 |
| `rpc-mount-failed` | 路由挂载失败，附原因 |

排查顺序：直接跑 `npm run doctor`，它会逐段检查并给出结论。

**注意**：Host 半体的代码改动**必须重启 DSH** 才能生效 ——
DSH 用同一个 URL 导入 `lib/index.js`，Node 会缓存该模块，所以"禁用再启用插件"
只会重新执行**旧代码**。改完 Host 代码后请重启，否则你验证的仍是上一版。

`boot.json` 的最后一条 phase 就是结论：

| phase | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `apply-called` | 进入了但没走完 —— 后续步骤失败（早先的事故就停在这一步） |
| `config-ok` | 配置校验通过 |
| `modules-ready` | 数据层与网络层构造完成 |
| `rpc-mounted` | 路由已挂上（客户端能通信） |
| `apply-completed` | 全部完成 |
| `apply-failed` | 失败，并附 message 与堆栈 |

> 教训写在 `inject` 的注释里：**不要为惰性使用的东西声明硬依赖。**
> 早期把 `sessionQuery` / `sessions` 也列进了 `inject`，而它们只在少数 RPC 处理函数里用到 ——
> 一旦取不到，整个插件就静静地不加载。

npm install
npm run build     # esbuild → lib/index.js（Host，ESM）+ lib/client.js（Client，CJS 包进 __ModuleLoader__）
npm test          # 314 项测试

装好并重启 DSH 后：

```

它会以一个**完全独立的进程**扮演另一个用户节点，在 9ms 内被运行中的插件发现、
